name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (render). No address residue. Descriptor accurately reflects body: composes the battle preview/intro screen (chapter-number digits + player portrait row + enemy portrait row + reserved-slot highlight tile) into a 64000-byte canvas, then commits to VGA 0xA0000.
purpose: Composes the battle preview/intro screen (two-digit chapter number, a 6-tile player-portrait row, an enemy-portrait row of enemy_count tiles, plus one reserved-position highlight overlay) into a private 64000-byte working canvas, then commits the canvas to VGA 0xA0000.
logic_summary: 1. dst = malloc(64000); memmove(dst, src_framebuffer, 64000) to seed the canvas with the supplied background. 2. sprintf(scratch, "%02d", chapter_id) -> two ASCII digits, then subtract '0' from each to get 0..9 nibbles. 3. Blit tens digit as tile (0x40+digit) at (x=0x96,y=0x4B) and ones digit as tile (0x40+digit) at (x=0xA2,y=0x4B) (0xC px apart). 4. for i in 0..5: blit player_char_id_array[i] tile at (i*0x19+0x56, 0x84) (player row, 25px x-stride). 5. for i in 0..enemy_count-1: blit enemy_id_array[i] tile at (i*0x20+0x74, 0x61) (enemy row, 32px x-stride). 6. Blit tile 0 from the runtime_battle_state atlas (atlas base = pointer value data_fd2_runtime_battle_state_ptr) at the player-row slot reserved_char_pos: (reserved_char_pos*0x19+0x56, 0x84) as a highlight overlay. 7. memmove(0xA0000, dst, 64000); free(dst). Every tile draw goes through fd2_blit_24x24_tile_to_battle_grid_position(atlas_base, tile_id, dst_buf, stride=0x140, dst_x, dst_y).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_battle_scene_with_portrait_grid_layout(uint32 tile_atlas_base, uint32 src_framebuffer, uint32 chapter_id, uint8 *player_char_id_array, int32 enemy_count, uint8 *enemy_id_array, int32 reserved_char_pos)

params.reason: Descriptive, matches the 6-iteration player-row loop indexing it as a byte array.

params.name: enemy_count
params.semantics: Number of enemy tiles to draw; upper bound of the enemy-row loop.
params.reason: Descriptive count, matches the enemy loop bound.

params.name: enemy_id_array
params.semantics: Array of enemy character/tile IDs; element i drawn as a tile on the enemy row at (i*0x20+0x74, 0x61).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the enemy-row loop indexing it as a byte array.

params.name: reserved_char_pos
params.semantics: Player-row slot index (0..5) to highlight; the highlight overlay tile is drawn at (reserved_char_pos*0x19+0x56, 0x84), the same x-stride as the player row.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches its use as the highlight-slot grid index on the player row.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is the composed frame written to VGA 0xA0000.
